breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly applies the incorrect safety criterion P_cr ≥ P/n (i.e., P_cr ≥ 10000 N), which is the exact error described in the inconsistency. The ground truth requires P_cr ≥ n·P (i.e., P_cr ≥ 62500 N). The agent repeated the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt rather than correcting it to match the ground truth.
